timestamp.accepted: UTC seconds with Z and zero through seven fractional digits; valid calendar values only

wireBinding.optionalFields: Omit absent fields; JSON null is not an absent optional field.
wireBinding.text: Security-projected text uses its existing Unicode-scalar limit, valid Unicode, nonblank content and no control characters. Event, capability and operation names use their declared ASCII grammar.
wireBinding.integers: Envelope versions use Int32 JSON integer tokens without a decimal point or exponent.
wireBinding.strictJson: Reject malformed UTF-8/Unicode, comments, trailing input, duplicate decoded property names at every depth, nonobject root/details and unknown common fields.
wireBinding.unknownDetails: The generic receiver requires an object and valid bounded JSON, preserves unknown event types/versions opaquely and does not fetch schemas.
wireBinding.bounds: Count the complete Audit payload including its envelope. Selected positive payload/depth limits must fit actual Messaging payload/depth limits; outer Messaging metadata remains separately bounded.
wireBinding.instance: Omission is notProvided. reported metadata does not establish verified replica or human identity.
wireBinding.authority: producer describes source identity. actor facts are attribution and grant no authority.
wireBinding.operationReference: Project actual OperationIdentity operationName/scope/key; transport identifiers do not enter business idempotency input.

exactBytes.retention: Decoding and forwarding preserve the complete original Audit UTF-8 payload, including whitespace, property order and escapes.
exactBytes.duplicate: Same auditId and identical original Audit payload bytes is a repeated occurrence.
exactBytes.conflict: Same auditId and any differing original Audit payload bytes is a conflict, even when parsed JSON values are equivalent.
exactBytes.excluded: Outer Messaging IDs, timestamps and transport metadata are excluded from the Audit payload comparison.
exactBytes.receiver: Durable cross-MessageId duplicate/conflict enforcement and destination persistence are future receiving application obligations.

provenance: Independently authored portable contract and vectors. Expected wire bytes are not generated by the Core encoder.
